selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations, along with the absence of hepatosplenomegaly and negative tests for other infections, support bacillary angiomatosis as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Herpes Simplex
rejected.why: Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus from an ulcer base

rejected.label: Angioedema
rejected.why: Complement C1 esterase inhibitor levels were within normal limits, and the patient's symptoms do not fully align with angioedema

rejected.label: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS)
rejected.why: While the patient's CD4 count improved, IRIS does not fully explain the specific symptoms of lip swelling and ulcerations
